title: Restricted Fourier Weight Observation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on $\\{−1,1\\}^n$, and let $J\\subseteq[n]$ and $S\\subseteq J$. Fix signs $z$ outside $J$ and signs $y,y'$ on $J$. The restricted Fourier weight observation is the product of the restriction coefficient observations at $y$ and at $y'$, using the same $f,J,S,z$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
$y$ and $y'$ assign signs to coordinates in $J$
